title: Frobenius n|p+1 gives r(t)<=2 UNCONDITIONALLY — count face closed on the inert-prime family, wall pinned to split n|p-1
evidence: Two separable claims. (1) The INERT closure is GENUINELY PROVEN and machine-verified. The Lean lemma repCount_le_two_of_dvd_succ (ArkLib/Data/CodingTheory/ProximityGap/RepCountFrobeniusBound.lean) is axiom-clean (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound): n|p+1 => Frobenius y->y^p acts as inversion on mu_n, so y solves the fixed deg-2 poly c^p X^2 - c c^p X + c, giving r(t)=#{y in mu_n: t-y in mu_n} <= 2 over ALL of F_{p^2}*; gvRepBound_of_dvd_succ (GVDvdSuccClosure.lean) upgrades this to GVRepBound 2 with M^3=8<=64n^2. Confirmed by exact-integer probe scripts/probes/_407_conn/C099_debug.py + C099_lift_test.py at proper dyadic subgroups n=2^mu (mu=3,4,5,6) over inert primes (p=71,79,271,367,1087,1151): max_{t in F_{p^2}*} r(t)=2 in every instance. (2) The PRIZE-RELEVANCE claim ('closes the count face, isolating the wall to split') is an obstruction-LOCALIZATION, not progress on the open core, and the proposed lift (attack_plan) FAILS structurally. THREE machine-verified facts kill the transfer: (a) DISJOINT FAMILIES — a prime with both n|p-1 and n|p+1 needs n|((p+1)-(p-1))=2, impossible for prize n=2^mu, mu>=3; the inert family the lemma closes never intersects the prize (split q=1 mod n) regime (C099_lift_test.py). (b) NO INERT PARTNER TO PAIR — F_{p^2}* is cyclic, so it has a UNIQUE order-n subgroup; for a split prime that subgroup is exactly mu_n subset F_p, on which Frobenius is the IDENTITY (verified: frob==identity True, frob==inversion False, all n,p), so the deg-2 collapse X^2-cX+1 has no analogue; the 'Frobenius-paired' sum sum chi(by)chi(by^p)=sum chi(2by) degenerates to the same Gauss period at frequency 2b — zero new cancellation. (c) WRONG OBJECT — the count face here is the LOW (2nd) additive moment E_2=sum r(t)^2; the prize wall W-BGK is the sup-norm B=max_b|sum_{y in mu_n} psi(by)| at HIGH moment r~log q, whose char-0 energy input is already proven in-tree (CLAUDE.md face 3) — the open residual is the char-p transfer of E_r at r~log q, untouched on either family. Split-regime probe C099_energy_surplus.py (n up to 2^7, beta~2-3): split r(t) reaches n and E_2 carries surplus = E_2 - (3n^2-3n) tracking Theta(n^4/p) (surplus/(n^4/p) in [0.4,1.8], order-1 with prime fluctuation) = the genuine char-p Stepanov surplus; inert side has r<=2 => zero surplus ever. So the surplus is real and prize-relevant, but the inert r<=2 anchor cannot bracket or bound it.
wall: W-BGK (with W-LamLeung as the char-0 energy input): the localization confirms the prize regime is exactly the split family n|p-1 where Frobenius is trivial, but leaves the open core unchanged — the high-moment (r~log q) char-p sqrt-cancellation B=max_b|sum_{y in mu_n} psi(by)| / equivalently the char-p transfer of the Lam-Leung energy bound E_r(mu_n)<=(2r-1)!! n^r to r~log q for thin dyadic mu_n at a prize prime. The inert lemma is the char-p analog of complex conjugation that exists ONLY when Frobenius=inversion, which fails on the split family by the disjointness theorem.
honest_note: PARTIAL, not a closure. What is proven (inert r(t)<=2, GVRepBound 2 on the entire n|p+1 family) is real, axiom-clean in-tree, and exactly machine-verified at proper dyadic subgroups; it is a clean char-p Garcia-Voloch bound. But it contributes NO leverage on the prize: the inert and split prime families are provably disjoint (gcd argument), F_{p^2}* offers no second order-n subgroup to Frobenius-pair with (cyclic => unique), and Frobenius is the identity on the split mu_n so the deg-2 mechanism is vacuous there. The attack_plan's CRT/quadratic-extension lift therefore has no teeth. It also addresses the wrong moment: the count face closed is E_2, while the wall is the high-moment sup-norm. Consistent with the campaign's repeated finding (DISPROOF_LOG O3/O5/O159: Frobenius/subfield routes are production-blocked in the prize's split-prime, q-prime regime). Honest value: a citable, formally-checked anchor showing the prize hardness is precisely the split-prime arithmetic (the inert baseline is trivially r<=2) — an explanatory bracket, not a bound. Welds back to W-BGK. All probes use exact integer arithmetic (sympy primality + explicit F_{p^2} multiplication, no floats). NOTE: an earlier draft probe (C099_inert_vs_split.py) had a generator-search bug reporting max=8 over F_p for the inert side; the corrected C099_debug.py/C099_lift_test.py confirm the true value is 2, matching the Lean lemma.
